verdict.rationale: Kintsugi does run work autonomously in the background. Connected platforms stay in sync after a one-time authorization, and the product watches nexus obligations, registers you, and files and remits on schedule. These are built-in, fixed compliance pipelines rather than automations the user designs. The MCP server only reads docs and never acts on the API, so it adds nothing agentic. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, custom triggers or schedules, agent-driven actions against the live API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the background behavior.
